governing_statute.value: D.C. Code title 1, chapter 6, subchapter XVII (Labor-Management Relations), ss. 1-617.01 to 1-617.18
governing_statute.quote: All employees shall have the right: (1) To organize a labor organization free from interference, restraint, or coercion; (2) To form, join, or assist any labor organization or to refrain from such activity; (3) To bargain collectively through representatives of their own choosing as provided in this subchapter
